note: Large Corps of Engineers campground in two loops (East End and West End) on open mowed grass along the south shore of Lake Sakakawea near Riverdale, about 6 miles from Garrison Dam. Playground and volleyball court; the nearest showers are at Downstream Campground, about 5 miles away. OHVs, golf carts and ATVs not allowed. Site length not published, but every site lists fifth wheels as permitted. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov record, rates, catalog and calendar read: USACE-run (Garrison Project), 67 non-electric sites in East/West End loops, $14 (2026, 2027), all reservable incl. same day, 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimums, 14 in 30; vault toilets, dump, seasonal drinking water. Groups confirmed/written; note cleaned (booking and site-count text moved to fields). Pin ok (84 m from the site centroid). Waterfront: stored lakeview, recommend lakefront with a caveat naming the east-shore sites (photos + lidar).
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakeview, not --AWH; stored evidence held it on the bluff rule because the bank height could not be read): recommend LAKEFRONT with a caveat. recreation.gov: 'open grassy area with lake views from most of the campsites with the sites being right on the water' and every site tagged 'Lakefront' (blanket tag, not evidence by itself). Measured: USGS 3DEP lidar transects from the catalog points to the ~561 m contour (about 1840 ft, a normal summer pool; lidar water ~560 m): site 021 (47.548469,-101.305119) 42 m down a steady 9% mowed-grass slope; 019 (47.548238,-101.304277) 44 m at ~11%; 018 (47.548216,-101.304000) similar; 008 (47.548297,-101.302558) 40 m and 007 (47.548289,-101.302355) 44 m, flat lawn then a ~2 m step (35-45%) at 16-24 m; 022 ~54 m at 12%. rec.gov photos of 018/019, 021/022 and 007/008 show a gravel pad, open mowed lawn with the table, a fringe of tall grass and the lake directly beyond, no road, trees only scattered. The west-point sites 034-044 (e.g. 038 at 47.548410,-101.311274) are also on open lawn ~40-48 m from the water, but sit atop a 5-6 m grassy bank at 27-37% (038: 567.5 m at 16 m out to 561.1 m at 40 m): lakeview by the bluff rule. Sites 010-017, 026-028 and the West End 050-067 sit behind the campground road or trees. All named sites are nightly, reservable sites. Caveat proposal: 'lakefront at sites 7, 8, 18, 19, 21 and 22 on the east shore (open lawn sloping to the water); the point sites sit on a 5-6 m bank'.
DAM CHECK: Garrison Dam is ~6 miles east; the campground is on the lake side at 565-568 m, 4-8 m above the ~560-561 m summer pool: not below the dam.
OPERATOR: run by USACE Garrison Project (recreation.gov org; staff email usace.army.mil), not a concession. federal / policy_ref federal:usace stands.

SEASON (not written): the rate table's peak season is 05-15..09-14 (2026) and 05-14..09-14 (2027); the 2027 calendar opens all 67 sites from 05-14 and April 2027 carries no dates. A rate season is not a campground season and no page states one; the USACE Garrison pages answer 403 (unread).
FIT: no Max Vehicle Length on any site; every site permits RV, Trailer and Fifth Wheel; photos show gravel pads on open lawn. No fit doubt.
ACCESS: rec.gov directions run from ND-200 via 37th Ave NW, 7th St NW and 36th Ave NW (county roads; surface not stated). No road, grade or 4WD warning on any page read.
PHONE: stored 701-654-7411 matches recreation.gov and Google: keep. WEBSITE: keep https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/251948 (USACE project pages refuse plain HTTP).

PIN: stored 47.547975,-101.310516 is 84 m from the centroid of the 67 catalog points (47.54788,-101.30940), in the East End loop: ok. Not a split: East End and West End are one recreation.gov facility ~250 m apart.
MIN STAY: minWeekendStay 2 / minHolidayWeekendStay 3 recorded (same pattern as other Garrison campgrounds; recreation.gov may relax them for same-day bookings).
